scope: Reviewed combined patch applied to pinned upstream source in isolated test checkouts; no Rust commit or PR updates
cache_scope: Separate fresh local sccache per release, persistent across its phases. Cross-build same-path profile invalidation is established separately by the recorded A/B/B micro-reproduction, not by cold release comparison.
release_scope: Fresh full windows-ci PGO, tools, docs, MSI, complete distribution and unmodified extracted-distribution tests; Microsoft native linkers; no added ThinLTO
linux_scope: Build opt-dist and run existing bootstrap/tool tests; not a full shared-LLVM release
replay_scope: One hosted Windows VM, each distribution's own rustc, Cargo and stdlib; one warmup and three measured rounds; native correctness outside timing
limits: Single producer per arm; no upstream private cache; dedicated 16-LP hardware does not prove upstream 8-LP timeout compliance. No automatic job retries.
review: Local diff approved by the user; contribution prose and Rust commit messages remain human-authored; upstream publication remains gated
